obsah:
Half of August is gone and our team hasn't stopped. We started in Žimutice at a small village harvest festival, where Čihi and Lukáš Valný rode.


A few individual MTB and Trial courses followed. On 8/8 we were supposed to have a double exhibition, but unfortunately one was cancelled because of the death of the organiser, a long-time client of ours. So we headed to Černovice, where the 20th edition of 'Černovicko se baví' took place. An hour-long workshop followed by an exhibition on the main stage, and a reunion after many years between Martin Šimůnek and the host and sound engineer.


And this weekend, on 15/8, we did 3 exhibitions: Lukáš Valný and Marek Tryner did an intimate event in Říčky near the local bike park, while Šimon, Čihi and the little ones went to an event in Kvítkov near Česká Lípa and then opened for the band NoName in Mistrovice. So we alternated between audiences of a few dozen visitors and an event for a few thousand people. To be honest, all the events were accompanied by exhausting heat, which has hopefully eased for a week now, but we're grateful for the invitations and the chance to present our sport.
